responsibility: Exports the user-facing intrinsic header for PowerPC paired-single floating-point support, primarily for 750CL-style targets. It defines an 8-byte vector type alias, publishes macro names for paired arithmetic, reciprocal, sqrt, merge, load/store, compare, and select builtins, and provides condition-code constants and convenience wrappers for the paired compare predicates so C/C++ code can call the backend’s paired builtins with the expected API names.
same_name_distinction: This is the public paired-single intrinsic header, exposing builtin names, vector typedefs, and compare helper macros to user code. Unlike paired.md, it is not the backend RTL description of ps_* instruction patterns.
